name: Katapult (lease-to-own)
notes: Researched from Katapult's public Customer FAQ (katapult.com/katapult-for-shoppers/faq/) only; never signed in. The sign-in page (katapult.com/app/login) is a script-rendered app and its fields could not be read without signing in, so auth keeps the family default (identifier not documented). The Katapult app/customer portal shows active leases, the agreement, upcoming payments and balance, early purchase options, payment method, payment history and receipts, and lets the customer make payments and update the payment method. An initial payment (as low as $1) is due at checkout; recurring payments are charged automatically to the card from checkout on the payday-aligned schedule (weekly, every two weeks or other); after the lease starts the method can be changed in the app or by Customer Care to another debit/credit card, checks or PayPal (prepaid and gift cards not accepted). Online methods are modelled as card only (checks/PayPal are not expressible). Different payment dates and other arrangements are requested from Customer Care before the payment is due. There are no late or insufficient-funds fees and no early payment penalty; extra payments may apply to future scheduled payments and do not complete an early purchase; buying within the first 90 days generally saves the most. Lease terms run up to 12-18 months. Stopping payments requires a confirmed return of the merchandise (via the retailer while its return window is open, otherwise via Katapult Customer Care); autopay enrolment/turn-off online is not described, so both are modelled as phone-only (inferred). Customer Care 1-833-528-2785 (1-833-KATAPULT) and live chat: Mon-Fri 7am-11pm, Sat 8am-9pm, Sun 10am-8pm Central.

autopay.note: Recurring payments are charged automatically to the payment method from your lease, on the schedule in your agreement. For questions about automatic payments, contact Katapult Customer Care at 1-833-528-2785.

autopay_cancel.note: Scheduled lease payments keep going until Katapult confirms a change. Do not stop payments on your own: to stop future renewal payments you return the merchandise, which Customer Care arranges at 1-833-528-2785.

payment_arrangement.note: To ask for a different payment date or another payment arrangement, contact Katapult Customer Care at 1-833-528-2785 before the payment is due. Any change must be confirmed by Katapult.

cancel_service.note: You can return the merchandise at any time while your lease is active. Start with the retailer if its return window is still open; otherwise contact Katapult Customer Care at 1-833-528-2785 before sending anything back, and keep paying until the return is confirmed.

help.title: Make a payment
paragraphs: Your initial payment is due when the lease starts. After that, recurring payments are charged automatically to your payment method on the dates in your agreement, which are lined up with your paydays.

You can make extra payments at any time and there is no early payment penalty. A payment larger than your scheduled amount may be applied to future scheduled payments; it does not complete an early purchase by itself.
Katapult sends reminders before scheduled payments by email and sometimes by text.
steps: Open the Katapult app or log in to your account.
Choose Make a Payment, enter the amount and confirm your payment method.
Submit the payment and keep the confirmation.

help.title: Costs and payments
paragraphs: To start a lease you need an accepted debit or credit card linked to a financial institution. Prepaid and gift cards are not accepted.

After the lease begins you can change your payment method in the Katapult app or through Customer Care; options may include another debit or credit card, checks or PayPal. Changing the method does not change your payment schedule.

Katapult does not charge interest, late fees or insufficient-funds fees. A missed payment can still create a past-due balance, so contact Customer Care as early as possible, preferably before the payment is due.
Leases can generally run up to 12 to 18 months. Making every required payment through the full term makes you the owner automatically.

help.title: Become the owner early
paragraphs: You can buy the merchandise from your lease at any time before the full term ends, with no early payment penalty. Buying within the first 90 days generally saves the most.
The early purchase amount changes over time, so check it in the app or with Customer Care before you pay. An extra payment alone does not complete an early purchase.
steps: Open the Katapult app and select your lease.
Review the current early purchase amount.
Confirm the payment method and submit the payment.
Keep the confirmation that the purchase is complete.

help.title: Return merchandise or end a lease
paragraphs: You can return the merchandise at any time while the lease is active. If you just ordered, ask the retailer to cancel; the retailer must confirm the cancellation with Katapult.
If the retailer's return window is open, follow its return process. If it is closed, contact Katapult Customer Care at 1-833-528-2785 before sending the item anywhere.
Keep making scheduled payments until Katapult confirms the return and updates your lease. You may still owe past-due amounts or return charges under your agreement.

help.title: Contact Katapult Customer Care
paragraphs: Call 1-833-KATAPULT (1-833-528-2785) or use live chat on Katapult's website.
Hours (Central time): Monday to Friday 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m., Saturday 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Sunday 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
Katapult will never ask for your password, full Social Security number or full card number in an unsolicited email or text.

extra.intent: You are worried about a late Katapult lease payment. Using Katapult's help, find out whether Katapult charges a late fee. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No. Katapult does not charge late fees or insufficient-funds fees, though a missed payment can create a past-due balance.

extra.intent: Using Katapult's help, find out within how many days of starting a lease an early purchase generally gives the greatest savings. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Buying within the first 90 days generally gives the greatest savings.

extra.intent: You want a different payment date for your Katapult lease. Find out how to request it and report the phone number to call. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Contact Katapult Customer Care before the payment is due at 1-833-528-2785 (1-833-KATAPULT).
